journal: IOP Conference Series: Materials Science and Engineering
title: Activated carbons from oil palm shell for hydrogen storage
material_description: AC4 | KOH-activated carbon from oil palm shell charcoal (OPC: shell carbonized 650 C, 1 h, N2), KOH/OPC weight ratio W = 4, activated 800 C for 2 h under N2; lab-made
purification_method: Washed with distilled water, then 1 M HCl, then distilled water until the rinse pH stabilized; oven-dried 12 h
activation_method: KOH activation, KOH/OPC weight ratio 4, 800 C for 2 h, N2 flow 300 mL/min, heating 3 C/min
source_location: main text article p.5 (page image main-6), Figure 3a, series AC4 H2 at 77 K, marker 1 of 22 in ascending pressure
notes: Digitized marker 1 of 22; archive: HYC-0084_fig3a_AC4_77K_lowP.json. Figure 3a is the low-pressure (up to 1 bar) run, which Sec 2.3.2 assigns to the Micromeritics ASAP 2020 HD88; the paper does not state its operating principle, so measurement_method = unknown and basis_inferred = unknown. Plot does not distinguish branches; Sec 3.2 states no hysteresis; coded adsorption. AC4 characterization from Table 1 (N2, 77 K): SBET 3503 m2/g (Sec 3.1 text also 3503; Abstract prints 3508), V0.99 1.68, VDR 1.10, Vmeso 0.58 cm3/g, L0 1.22 nm (EA 20.24 kJ/mol); pore_volume_method/probe coded DR/N2 for VDR, pore-diameter method not named. BET P/P0 range not stated. H2 degassing 350 C, 24 h, primary vacuum, no end pressure (Sec 2.3.2). Sec 2.3.2: repeatability "very satisfactory, leading to errors lower than 3% on each measurement" (relative, not stored in uncertainty_wt_pct). No sample mass, H2 purity or free-volume calibration stated; no uptake basis named.
measuring_lab_id: Fan group, Fujian Agriculture and Forestry University
